entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I assist you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand tracker I bought. I need a return label.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your order, could I please get your name and email address?
It's Mark Peterson. M-A-R-K. The email is markpete@email.com. Just hurry it up.
Thank you, Mark. I see your order here for the VeloBand Pulse. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no issue. I just don't like it. I decided to go with something else. It's basically brand new. I want my money back.
I see. I'm just reviewing the details of your order and I see that the band was delivered to you on December 30th of last year. That would make it 29 days ago.
And? So what? Are you going to send me the label or are you going to waste more of my time?

Sir, I'm afraid I have some difficult news. According to our return policy, which is specific to wearable electronic devices like the VeloBand Pulse, the return window is 10 days from the date of delivery. At 29 days, it is unfortunately too late to process a return.
Are you joking? Ten days?! That's a scam! I've never heard of such a ridiculous policy! It's been sitting in the box!

I understand your frustration, but this policy is in place for very important health and safety reasons. Because the device is worn directly against the skin, after this amount of time we cannot accept it back due to strict hygiene and sanitation protocols.
Hygiene? I barely wore it! This is unbelievable! I want to speak to a manager right now! This is theft!
I can appreciate your position, but my manager is bound by the exact same company policy. For an item like this, the sanitation rules are a hard stop for us. There are no exceptions they can provide.

I don't care what you 'appreciate'! Get me someone who can actually do something! This is a joke! I'm going to write a review on every single website about this. I'll make sure everyone knows VeloFit rips people off with its scam policy!

I am sorry you feel that way, Mark. The decision isn't meant to be difficult, it's based solely on the time that has passed and our non-negotiable hygiene standards. As I said, it is simply too late. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Help me with? You haven't helped me at all! You're useless! Forget it!
